inference_engine: Work Luna semantic inference; no external provider/API
constraints: Human truth joined only after inference outputs were frozen and remote hash verified. No Round 1 overlap in primary. No post-as_of evidence used.

limited_oracle_diagnostic.applied_rule: Post-inference only: suppress rows with human announcement_missing=true or human teacher_related=true; all other labels remain autonomous.
limited_oracle_diagnostic.scope: Limited post-inference diagnostic using human missing and teacher flags only; not a full oracle and not production capability.

limitations: No complete oracle over dates, audience, temporal status, actionability, or historical-reference fields can be computed because those gold primitives are unavailable.
